company.name: Traya
company.description:
Nestlé S.A. is the world's largest food and beverage company, based in Vevey, Switzerland. Established in 1905 from the merger of the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company and Farine Lactée Henri Nestlé, the company has a rich history rooted in food preservation and nutrition. Nestlé operates in nearly 200 countries, with hundreds of factories producing a wide range of products.

The company offers a diverse portfolio that includes infant nutrition, dairy products, chocolate, beverages, frozen and prepared foods, cereals, and pet food. Notable brands include Nescafé, KitKat, and Stouffer’s. Nestlé emphasizes convenience and nutrition, continually investing in research and development to enhance its offerings. With a strong global presence, Nestlé remains committed to providing quality food and beverage options to consumers worldwide.
